signal={} Y,Yo,C,I,Q,RGB={},{},{},{},{},{} sq,sq2={},{} hdI,hdQ={},{} hdcolor={} igB=input.getBool restarted=true y=0 rotphase={} rotphase[0]={-74.9505,115.4133} --YIQ to YCbCr conversion matrix rotphase[1]={81.8215,53.1356} pgT=property.getText key=pgT('key') for i=-864,6919 do hdI[i]=0 hdQ[i]=0 I[i]=0 Q[i]=0 end for i=-3456,27679 do Y[i]=0 end
HDY={} HDC={} for x=0,159 do HDY[x]=0 HDC[x]=60 end
playing,rec=false,false peremotka=0 strf=string.format
for i=0,38 do --precalculate squares sq[i]=math.abs((i-19)/18)*((i-19)/18)*0.5957 end for n=0,26 do sq2[n] = math.abs((n-13)/12)*((n-13)/12)*0.5226 end blur={} local k,x,y,z for i=0,15359 do --precalculate upscaling k=i//2%80+i//320*80 x=k+i%2*2-1 y=k+(i//160%2*2-1)*80 z=y+i%2*2-1 if i%160==0 or i%160==159 then x=k z=y end if i>15199 or i<160 then y=k z=x end blur[i]={k,x,y,z} end
local sp,sup=string.pack,string.unpack function encode(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i) return sup('f',sp('I',a<<25|b<<18|c<<11|d<<4|i&15)),sup('f',sp('I',e<<25|f<<18|g<<11|h<<4|i>>4)) end function Ch(y2,x) --YIQ to YCbCr return clamp((rotphase[y%2][1]*I[x+y2*80]+rotphase[y%2][2]*Q[x+y2*80]+60.5)//1,0,120) end
function clamp(x,y,z) if x<y then x=y end if x>z then x=z end return x end k=1 function isinRect(x,y,X,Y)return touchx>=x and touchx<=X and touchy>=y and touchy<=Y and pressed end
brl=255 con=2.2 sat=1 framerate=FRAMERATE_HERE tickrate=60 framecount=FRAMECOUNT_HERE local a,b,c=0,0,0 function onTick() lpressed=pressed pressed=input.getBool(1) touchx=input.getNumber(3) touchy=input.getNumber(4) if not lpressed then if isinRect(58,8,70,18) then peremotka=0 end if isinRect(25,20,58,26) then k=1 restarted=true end playing=playing~=isinRect(58,8,70,18) --toggle play rec=rec~=isinRect(3,10,8,21) --toggle SWMI output if isinRect(47,10,56,16) then if peremotka==-1 then --rewind peremotka=0 playing=false else peremotka=-1 playing=true end end if isinRect(72,10,82,16) then --fast forward if peremotka==1 then peremotka=0 playing=false else peremotka=1 playing=true end end end if (k==1 and peremotka==-1) or (k==framecount and (peremotka==1 or playing and peremotka==0)) then peremotka=0 playing=false end lnfr=nfr if playing then if peremotka==0 then if rec then nfr=y==173 if nfr then k=math.min(k+1,framecount) tick=false end else k=math.min(math.max(k+framerate/tickrate,1),framecount) --advance frames end end k=math.min(math.max(k+peremotka*8*framerate/tickrate,1),framecount) --fast forward/rewind end if playing and not rec or restarted or tick or igB(3) or rec and (nfr or lnfr) then restarted=false
if tick then
local Y,I,Q,RGB,blur,R,G,B=Y,I,Q,RGB,blur for i=0,15359 do local b=blur[i] local I2=I[b[1]]*0.5625+I[b[2]]*0.1875+I[b[3]]*0.1875+I[b[4]]*0.0625 --upscaling the color local Q2=Q[b[1]]*0.5625+Q[b[2]]*0.1875+Q[b[3]]*0.1875+Q[b[4]]*0.0625 R=Y[i]+0.9469*I2+0.6236*Q2 --YIQ to RGB conversion G=Y[i]-0.2748*I2-0.6357*Q2 B=Y[i]-1.1000*I2+1.7000*Q2 R=R>0 and R or 0 G=G>0 and G or 0 B=B>0 and B or 0 R=(R^2.2*255+.5)//1 G=(G^2.2*255+.5)//1 B=(B^2.2*255+.5)//1 RGB[i]=((R<255 and R or 255)<<16)+((G<255 and G or 255)<<8)+(B<255 and B or 255) end
tick=false else text=pgT("frame_"..strf('%.0f',k).."a")..pgT("frame_"..strf('%.0f',k).."b")..pgT("frame_"..strf('%.0f',k).."c")
for i=0,15359 do --convert everything back signal[i]=key:find(text:sub(i+1,i+1),nil,true)-1 end
for i=0,1919 do hdcolor[i]=key:find(text:sub(i+15361,i+15361),nil,true)-1 hdI[i*2]=hdcolor[i]%3 hdQ[i*2]=(hdcolor[i]//3)%3 hdI[i*2+1]=(hdcolor[i]//9)%3 hdQ[i*2+1]=(hdcolor[i]//27) end
local sign,bl,lr,tb,ch local signal,Y,I,Q=signal,Y,I,Q for k=0,3839 do sign=signal[k*4+1]*111+signal[k*4+2] bl=(signal[k*4]/110) --2x2 block decoding lr=(sign%23-11)/11 tb=((sign//23)%23-11)/11 ch=((sign//529)-11)/11 lr=(lr*math.abs(lr)) tb=(tb*math.abs(tb)) ch=(ch*math.abs(ch)) Y[k*2+k//80*160]=(1+lr+tb+ch)*bl Y[k*2+k//80*160+1]=(1-lr+tb-ch)*bl Y[k*2+k//80*160+160]=(1+lr-tb-ch)*bl Y[k*2+k//80*160+161]=(1-lr-tb+ch)*bl I[k]=sq[signal[k*4+3]%13*3+hdI[k]]*sat Q[k]=sq2[signal[k*4+3]//13*3+hdQ[k]]*sat end tick = true end end if rec then pn=y<72 and 1 or -1 if y>5 and y<66 then y2=y-6 a,b,c=8/5,1,.5 elseif y>71 and y<108 then y2=y-72 a,b,c=8/3,1.8,.8 elseif y>107 and y<172 then y2=y-108 y3,y4=(y2*5/2+.5)//1,(y2//2*5/2+.5)//1 for x=0,95 do HDY[x]=clamp(((Y[x*160+y3+1]-Y[x*160+y3])*120+121)//2,0,120) end for x=0,47 do HDC[x]=(Ch(x,y4+1)-Ch(x,y4)+121)//2 end else y2=-1 end if y<108 then local y3,y4=(y2*a+b)//1,(y2*a+c)//1 for x=0,95 do local x2,x3=(x*5/3+.5)//1,(x*5/3+1)//1 HDY[x]=clamp(((Y[y3*160+x2]+pn*Y[y4*160+x2]+Y[y3*160+x3]+pn*Y[y4*160+x3])*120-120*pn+122)//4,0,120) end local Cbr1,Cbr2=(y2//2*a+b)//1,(y2//2*a+c)//1 for x=0,47 do local x2,x3=(x*5/3+.5)//1,(x*5/3+1)//1 HDC[x]=(Ch(Cbr1,x2)+pn*Ch(Cbr2,x2)+Ch(Cbr1,x3)+pn*Ch(Cbr2,x3)-120*pn+122)//4 end end for i=0,15 do --video output encoder local comp1,comp2=encode(HDY[i*6],HDY[i*6+1],HDY[i*6+2],HDY[i*6+3],HDY[i*6+4],HDY[i*6+5],HDC[i*3],HDC[i*3+1],HDC[i*3+2]) output.setNumber(i*2+1,comp1) output.setNumber(i*2+2,comp2) end y=(y+1)%174 output.setBool(1,y==173) output.setBool(2,y%2==0) output.setBool(4,y==173 and rec) output.setBool(24,true) output.setBool(25,true) end output.setBool(24,rec) end
local s=screen local sc=s.setColor local sd=s.drawRectF local RGB=RGB function onDraw() if s.getWidth()==160 then for i=0,15359 do --drawing the image local x=RGB[i] sc(x>>16,x>>8,x) sd(i%160,i//160,1,1) end else s.setColor(200,50,0) s.drawRectF(0,0,96,32) s.setColor(0,0,0) s.drawText(25,20,'restart') s.drawRectF(0,0,41,7) s.setColor(255,255,255) local str=strf('%.0f',k//(framerate*60)) while #str<2 do str='0'..str end str=str..':' if k//framerate%60>9 then str=str..strf('%.0f',k//framerate%60) else str=str..'0'..strf('%.0f',k//framerate%60) end str=str..':' if k%framerate//1>9 then str=str..strf('%.0f',k%framerate//1) else str=str..'0'..strf('%.0f',k%framerate//1) end s.drawText(1,1,str) if playing then s.drawRectF(60,7,3,12) s.drawRectF(66,7,3,12) else s.drawTriangleF(70,13,60,8,60,18) end s.drawText(11,11,'SWMI') s.drawTriangleF(51,13,56,10,56,16) s.drawTriangleF(47,13,52,10,52,16) s.drawTriangleF(77.5,13,72,10,72,16) s.drawTriangleF(81.5,13,76,10,76,16) s.setColor(15,15,15) s.drawRectF(4,10,4,11) s.setColor(0,0,0) if rec then s.drawRectF(4,10,4,4) else s.drawRectF(4,17,4,4) end s.setColor(200,50,0) s.drawRectF(72,10,1,5) s.drawRectF(76,10,1,2) s.drawRectF(76,13,1,2) end end
